mapper.sql: p.id, p.project_name, p.province_code, p.city_code, p.industry_code, p.investment_min, p.investment_max, p.requirements, p.project_status, p.owner_id, u.username AS owner_username, p.address, p.area_min, p.area_max, p.rent_price, p.facilities, p.district_code, p.building_type, p.target_area_min, p.target_area_max, p.created_at, p.updated_at
FROM crm_project p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.owner_id = u.id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM crm_project WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_project (project_name, province_code, city_code, industry_code, investment_min, investment_max, requirements, project_status, owner_id, created_by) VALUES (#{projectName}, #{province}, #{city}, #{industry}, #{min}, #{max}, #{requirements}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{actor})
